notes.title: Combat League has Started!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to the first update for Combat League, the first of many on our journey![/b]

If you have reached this point, welcome and thanks for having a look.

Combat League is our spin on Rocket League, World of Tanks, Pro Skater and Speedball combined neatly into one arcade fun experience.
The team with the highest points at the end of the match wins.

How do you score points?
Scoring goals, making saves, eliminating opponents, assisting others and doing stunts (donuts, jumps, air time, slalom etc.)
Chain them all together for a killer combo score!

Here's a quick 'first look' gif of the Blizzard peak map:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41196557/9fd1475e483b404dea6188e0176488f7536b3ccb.gif[/img]

We'll have additional maps, vehicles, weapons, aerials and more to show with each update.

Please Wishlist and Follow on here!

Here's another little clip from the Coal Shed map:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41196557/694c16fe7bcdd458a99ac7d8329584f3f95a0ecc.gif[/img]

Thanks for checking it out and we'll be back with more soon! ːsteamhappyː
